layout.ordering: descending anchor expression, gene id as tie-break, with the perturbed gene moved to position 0
layout.softmax_over: the tokens of the same pass; the response is mu divided by that pass's total count, so passes are comparable
layout.count_clip_note: the model's own training-time clip; a query value above it saturates
layout.masked_variant: not applicable: a causal mask means a gene never sees its own value, so this model is natively in the masked regime

sign_convention: perturbed minus baseline; a positive entry means raising the perturbed gene raises the model's prediction for the read-out gene. Zero-out uses this convention, not the paper's reversed one
expression_floor_note: the read-out set is the inclusive floor; each gene's pooled control level travels with the block so a higher floor is a column mask

uniform_virtual.description: every supplied gene pinned at 3.6751 CP10K, the uniform share of a 10,000-count virtual cell; the paper's construction, and far off the distribution the models were trained on

mean_control.description: the pooled non-targeting control mean expression profile of this cell line, restricted to the read-out genes; the on-distribution counterpart

individual_cells.description: 4 real non-targeting control cells, each converted to CP10K so every anchor sits at one depth; responses are averaged over the cells and their spread is recorded
individual_cells.per_cell_spread: responses averaged over cells; see summary rows

substitutions: compile_block_mask disabled (eager flex-attention block mask) so that a single-cell forward pass does not pay a torch.compile warm-up

contract.input_normalization: raw counts, clipped at 30, paired with gene tokens; counts enter the attention score as log1p(count + 1e-6) on the right-shifted sequence, and one auxiliary assay token ('10x 3' v3') is prepended. Sequence length is fixed at 2047 gene tokens plus the assay token, so the gene universe is covered in several passes.
contract.output_semantics: predicted share of the cell's total counts assigned to that gene, conditioned on the gene's own identity and on the identity and count of every gene earlier in the ordering. Reported as mu / total counts so values are comparable across passes; raw mu is not.
contract.information_flow: autoregressive, causal mask over the gene sequence
contract.symmetry_evidence: the causal mask makes the response structurally asymmetric: gene j responds to gene i only when i precedes j. Demonstrated by the ordering probe recorded alongside this contract.
substitutions: compile_block_mask disabled (eager flex-attention block mask) so that a single-cell forward pass does not pay a torch.compile warm-up
contract.notes: The gene ordering is descending count in the cell. The universe needs several passes, and each begins with the same 256-gene context block (the highest-count genes, with the source gene at position 0 for the Jacobian pass), so every gene is read against the same prefix and no pass is left without counts to divide. Genes with zero counts in this cell still receive tokens; a zero count is outside the support of the zero-truncated Poisson likelihood the model was trained with, so those entries describe the model's behaviour on a gene it did not observe rather than a fitted prediction. Token-id alignment against the checkpoint's own vocabulary: {'checked': 23830, 'mismatched': 0, 'special_token_order_from_checkpoint': ['unknown', '[PAD]', '[START]', '[END]', '[RD]', '[CELL]', '[MASK]']}.

uniform_virtual.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged
uniform_virtual.gradient_features_usable_for: direction and ranking only; magnitudes move with the step

mean_control.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged
mean_control.gradient_features_usable_for: direction and ranking only; magnitudes move with the step

individual_cells.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged
individual_cells.gradient_features_usable_for: direction and ranking only; magnitudes move with the step

uniform_virtual.sign_check_note: fraction whose own predicted output RISES when its input rises; a model that reverts to a population level can fail this while still being correctly wired
uniform_virtual.magnitude_check_note: fraction whose own entry is the largest response in the vector; this is the wiring guard
uniform_virtual.permutation_note: the same test after shuffling the read-out gene order; it must collapse to chance for the guard to have power

mean_control.sign_check_note: fraction whose own predicted output RISES when its input rises; a model that reverts to a population level can fail this while still being correctly wired
mean_control.magnitude_check_note: fraction whose own entry is the largest response in the vector; this is the wiring guard
mean_control.permutation_note: the same test after shuffling the read-out gene order; it must collapse to chance for the guard to have power

individual_cells.sign_check_note: fraction whose own predicted output RISES when its input rises; a model that reverts to a population level can fail this while still being correctly wired
individual_cells.magnitude_check_note: fraction whose own entry is the largest response in the vector; this is the wiring guard
individual_cells.permutation_note: the same test after shuffling the read-out gene order; it must collapse to chance for the guard to have power

masked.reason: the model is autoregressive: a gene never sees its own value, so it is natively in the masked regime and a masked variant would be the same query

coverage.selection_rule: stratified sample of 250 at seed 42, 125 per stratum, drawn from the in-scope set; the individual-cell and masked subsets are nested inside it
coverage.in_scope_definition: perturbations in strata S3, S4_highest whose target gene is also a read-out gene of this cell line, so it can be perturbed at all
coverage.comparability_note: a block at partial coverage and a block at full coverage share the perturbed genes of the smaller one but not its row order; join on perturbed_gene_id, never on row index, and do not compare a per-block aggregate across two different coverages
coverage.annotated_after_extraction: added by features.annotate_coverage: the block was extracted before the coverage record existed. The selector was re-run and reproduces this block's perturbed table exactly, so the record describes the features as shipped; no array changed.

superseded_by.note: this 250-gene block is kept for provenance; the canonical block for transcriptformer / hepg2 covers every in-scope perturbation. Read feature_index/blocks.json rather than globbing the feature tree, and join on perturbed_gene_id, never on row index: the two coverages share genes but not row order.
